 Game Recap: Lakers 127, Warriors 105
 Oct 22, 2026
 The Los Angeles Lakers defeated the Golden State Warriors, 127-105, in their home opener. The Lakers improve to 1-0 on the season, while the Warriors fall to 0-1.
